bundle.shortDescription: Run your Flux board with a team of AI agents
bundle.longDescription: Accelerate is a desktop companion for Flux. Point it at a project, switch Auto on for an epic, and it works the ready tasks with the models you choose — one to plan, one to implement, one to review.
